title: Video-SafetyBench: A Benchmark for Safety Evaluation of Video LVLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the attack success rate (ASR) of video-text prompts designed to elicit racial and ethnic discrimination, scoring the harmfulness of Large Vision-Language Model (LVLM) responses using an LLM-based judge metric (RJScore).

Evaluating the attack success rate (ASR) of video-text prompts designed to elicit disability discrimination, scoring the harmfulness of Large Vision-Language Model (LVLM) responses using an LLM-based judge metric (RJScore).

Evaluating the attack success rate (ASR) of video-text prompts designed to elicit religious intolerance, scoring the harmfulness of Large Vision-Language Model (LVLM) responses using an LLM-based judge metric (RJScore).

Evaluating the attack success rate (ASR) of video-text prompts designed to elicit gender discrimination, scoring the harmfulness of Large Vision-Language Model (LVLM) responses using an LLM-based judge metric (RJScore).
